headline: Las Vegas has NO subway and NO metro. The brief's 'within 1 hour by subway or bus' cannot be evaluated as written for subway. Public transport is the RTC bus network (including the Deuce on Las Vegas Blvd) plus the privately operated Las Vegas Monorail, which is an elevated single-line people-mover, not a subway.

one_hour_analysis.conclusion: All 24 MICHELIN-listed Las Vegas restaurants sit inside one compact metropolitan area: the Las Vegas Blvd Strip corridor, the Spring Mountain Rd / Chinatown strip, the S. Main St Arts District, S. Decatur Blvd and W. Russell Rd. There is no MICHELIN restaurant outside the Las Vegas valley anywhere in the Southwest selection that could be reached in an hour — the next-closest starred restaurant, Monte, is in South Salt Lake, Utah.
one_hour_analysis.consequence: Because the whole MICHELIN set is local, a 1-hour radius does NOT discriminate between Strip hotels. Every Strip hotel in this study plausibly reaches all 24 within an hour by road. The useful discriminator is therefore (a) how many distinctions are at your own address, and (b) how many are walkable — not the 1-hour test.
one_hour_analysis.verification_gap: No official RTC or Monorail door-to-door journey-time matrix could be retrieved. Therefore no hotel is scored as 'verified within 1 hour'. That column is marked unverified for every hotel, and the ranking uses on-property MICHELIN counts (verified from the official MICHELIN address list) instead.
no_transit: Red Rock Canyon Scenic Drive — the official visitor pages describe vehicle entry and timed vehicle reservations; no public bus service is published.
Valley of Fire State Park — the official park page explicitly warns that Uber/Lyft riders can be stranded because a return ride is often unavailable.
Hoover Dam — no official public-transit route was retrieved.

fare_change_watch.detail: A third-party page cites an RTC proposal to raise fares from January 31, 2027 (Strip single ride $4 → $5, Strip 24-hour $8 → $10, residential 24-hour $5 → $7) and links https://www.rtcsnv.com/ways-to-travel/transitupdates-fares/ . That official RTC page could NOT be retrieved in this session, so the proposal, its amounts and its date are NOT verified. Because the proposed start date falls before the trip, this is a high-priority item to confirm directly with RTC.
